info.title: Ella API
info.description: Backend for the Ella English learning app

post.description:
Called once on first app launch with a device-generated UUID.
- If device_id is new → creates a user account silently, returns token
- If device_id exists → returns a fresh token for the existing user

The app stores the token locally. On subsequent launches it just
uses the stored token — this endpoint is only called if the token
is missing or expired.

get.description:
Returns the student's full learning memory as a unified object.
Combines profile, persona facts, skills progress, and next targets.

put.description:
Manually updates, overrides, or clears the child's permanent persona memory block.

Used to modify narrative facts or clear stored memory to reset the learning context.

post.description:
Generates a friendly opening question/starter from the AI tutor matching a selected topic.

Acts as a proxy call to the LLM (DeepSeek) using prompt rendering configured server-side.

Handles turn-by-turn logic during an active topic-based conversation session.

- Validates that the conversation session exists and belongs to the authenticated user.
- Sends the dialogue history to the LLM backend proxy.
- Applies custom coaching metrics (grammar, vocabulary, and fluency settings).
- Returns Zoe's next spoken reply alongside immediate grammar corrections.

Executes a dialogue turn during the voice placement screening test.

- Accepts the running transcript log.
- Queries the backend LLM state machine to decide if the test should continue or complete.
- Returns Zoe's next question OR a final CEFR assessment (`is_complete: true`) once enough evidence is gathered.

Performs post-session analysis on a completed conversation.

- Marks the conversation as completed in the database.
- Evaluates student performance (best moments, courage highlights, try-next-time recommendations).
- Extracts new student persona facts mentioned during the chat.
- Idempotently merges these facts with the child's permanent database `persona_memory` profile.
- Runs the LLM Judge to grade the conversation target skills.
- Deterministically merges grades into the user's `skills_progress` and updates next targets.

get.description:
Lists the full history of all completed voice placement tests for the authenticated student.

Enables progress tracking and comparative reviews over time.

post.description:
Finalizes and saves the result of the voice placement screening test.

- Creates a new placement history record.
- Persists the assessed CEFR level, level label, highlight summary, and full transcript.
- Updates the user's permanent profile with the graded level, level label, and interest tags.

get.description:
Fetches the student's latest active CEFR placement record.

Used to initialize level-specific vocabulary and prompt constraints in subsequent chat screens.
Returns the list of curriculum topics for the user home screen based on their CEFR level.
